items.q: How does Airbnb help protect hosts?
items.a: Airbnb includes built-in protections and support. Coverage and availability may vary by country and listing type.
Yes. You can set your availability, minimum nights, and house rules. Many hosts start with just a few nights per month.

items.q: How do I create a listing?
items.a: Add photos, set your price and availability, and publish when ready. You can update your listing anytime.

items.q: What do I need to get started?
items.a: A safe, clean space, clear house rules, and a way to communicate with guests through the app.

items.q: Do I need permits or licenses?
items.a: Rules depend on your location. Check local regulations and building rules before hosting.
A co-host can help with setup, messaging, cleaning coordination, and more. You decide what they can access.
